integrity: The included source programs reconstruct the complete graph and independent-set complex and verify a complete discrete-Morse acyclicity certificate; the independent program recomputes mod-two boundary ranks. No external independent audit has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: The result determines a single named folded-cube case, not a general family formula. The discrete-Morse conclusion depends on complete finite enumeration. Unindexed mathematical literature could contain an equivalent theorem.
